text: THE DBIM HOME PAGE'S BUTTONS, CAROUSEL CONTROLS AND LINKS NOW FOLLOW THE HANDOFF'S NEW DBIM COMPONENTS. View More, View Event and Show Latest Posts are the outline Button: 40px tall, 8/16 padding, labels in 14px Semi Bold capitals (12 on a phone). The banner, persona and partner arrows are 40px targets with 24px icons. Key Offerings, Important Links and the social 'View on' links are in the key colour, underlined in Blue 2 on hover, with a 2px key-colour focus ring. Nav items, tabs and About tiles take the Blue 5 hover and the key-colour focus border. Footer, What's New and list chevrons are 24px (DBIM 3.0 §3.4).
